units: <cite ref="Yoma 85a:11">Yoma 85ᵃ</cite> <he>לענין י׳</he> as regards the stages of embryonic formation.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>, beg. <he>כשם שיְצִירָתוֹ של אדם וכ׳</he> as well as the creation of man took place after that of the animals, so is the law concerning man (Lev. XII—XV) issued after that concerning animals (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">ib.</cite> XI).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14">Ib.</cite> <he>יְצִירת הוולד</he> the formation (development) of the embryo.—
<cite ref="Sotah 2a:9">Sot. 2ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a:21">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ארבעים יום קודם י׳ הוו׳ וכ׳</he> forty days before the embryo is formed, a divine voice goes forth &c.

<cite ref="Niddah 22b:48">Nidd. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דנין י׳ מי׳</he> we may draw an analogy between animals concerning whose formation the verb <he>יצר</he> is used (contrad. to <cite ref="B01157"><he>ברא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Ketubot 8a:9">Keth. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>חדא י׳ הואי</he> there was one act of formation for Adam und Eve (male and female persons combined, v.
<cite ref="Eruvin 18a">Ib.</cite> <he>שתי י׳ הואי</he> there were two different formations.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:5">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> (ref. to <he>וייצר</he> with two <cite ref="J00000"><he>י</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:7">Gen. II, 7</cite>) <he>שתי י׳ וכ׳</he> two formations, one referring to Adam, the other to Eve; <he>יצירה לשבעה וכ׳</he> there is a viable birth at seven months, and one at nine months.
<cite ref="Genesis 2:7">Ib.</cite> <he>שתי י׳ יצירה מן התחתונים וכ׳</he> two creations, one partaking of the nature of earthly creatures, the other of heavenly beings. Y. Yeb. II, 5ᶜ bot.
